title: Issuer
description: A card-issuing bank or institution. Kept as a flat list separate from cards so bank-level metadata (support phone, benefits administrator PDF) isn't duplicated per card.

id.description: Stable lowercase-dash id referenced by cards[].issuerId, e.g. 'chase', 'american-express'.

benefitsGuideUrl.description: Link to the issuer/underwriter's 'Guide to Benefits' document, when publicly available. This is often the authoritative source for insurance-type benefit terms (rental car coverage, purchase protection, trip delay), which are usually NOT fully described on the marketing pages agents will otherwise crawl.

_note.description: Free-text flag for a transitional or uncertain situation an update agent should revisit (e.g. an issuer mid-acquisition, a program in transition to a different issuer). Not machine-consumed; delete once the situation resolves and this issuer's fields reflect the settled state.
